sectors.name: Cybersecurity & Risk
sectors.keywords: security analyst, cloud security, threat detection, GRC
sectors.focus: identity engineering, incident response, cloud configuration audits and defensible risk controls
checks: Differentiate continuous SOC shifts from project-based threat engineering before you commit to hours.
Ask whether risk roles require policy work, technical implementation or both.
Explain a threat model, escalation path and one measurable control you helped improve.
Confirm incident on-call expectations, data handling permissions and security clearance requirements.
sectors.evaluation: A good security application shows the judgment behind a mitigation, not only a list of tools. Document the scope, threat assumptions, test evidence and what changed after review.

sectors.name: Cloud Engineering & AI Infrastructure
sectors.keywords: cloud engineer, site reliability, data platform, AI infrastructure
sectors.focus: production reliability, cloud cost controls, platform automation and safe AI system operations
checks: Separate site-reliability roles from platform implementation and data engineering in the vacancy description.
Document cloud services, deployment ownership, incident response and measurable reliability impact.
Discuss cost optimization with availability, latency and data retention constraints explicitly.
Confirm work-arrangement details and whether engineering on-call time is compensated.
sectors.evaluation: A strong project story compares deployment choices, rollback design and a production incident. Avoid presenting an experimental AI demo as proof of operating a regulated, resilient system.

sectors.name: Banking, Insurance & Financial Compliance
sectors.keywords: financial analyst, risk manager, AML, insurance compliance
sectors.focus: regulatory reporting, financial controls, AML reviews and quantitative decision support
checks: Read the vacancy for the exact financial function: front office, operations, audit or oversight.
Ask whether accounting, risk or regulated advisory credentials are mandatory for the jurisdiction.
Describe controls, reconciliations and the audit trail of one financial decision without disclosing confidential data.
Verify licensing, confidentiality duties, background screening and reporting-line independence.
sectors.evaluation: An application is more convincing when it connects a technical skill to an auditable financial outcome. Never claim regulated credentials or professional authorization that you do not hold.

sectors.name: Life Sciences, Medical Technology & Pharma
sectors.keywords: biotech research, clinical operations, quality systems, medical devices
sectors.focus: regulated documentation, laboratory workflows, clinical operations, quality assurance and medical technology
checks: Distinguish patient-facing licensed roles from technical, research and business roles.
Verify applicable professional registration, laboratory training or quality-system experience.
Describe how you recorded deviations and corrected a process while protecting personal health data.
Check research ethics, relocation terms and any locally required language competency.
sectors.evaluation: Medical and biotech employers may value traceable procedure, reproducibility and patient safety more than an impressive project description. Describe what you verified and where your authority stopped.

sectors.name: Engineering, Energy Systems & Industrial Technology
sectors.keywords: electrical engineer, grid systems, industrial automation, renewables
sectors.focus: industrial controls, energy efficiency, systems integration, operational safety and project delivery
checks: Confirm the engineering discipline and whether site travel or shift work is required.
Check professional registration, safety certification and drawing-standard requirements in the destination country.
Prepare one engineering trade-off with data about cost, reliability and maintenance.
Verify commissioning obligations, contractor status and the real workplace location.
sectors.evaluation: Engineering employers need evidence of a design choice surviving real constraints. Show calculations and verification methods without overstating safety approval or professional registration.

countries.name: United States
countries.locations: New York, Seattle, Austin, Boston and remote-eligible US roles
countries.visa: US work authorization, visa sponsorship and employer-specific location eligibility are separate questions. A remote label does not authorize working from another country.
countries.screen: Compare state-specific location requirements, total benefits and on-call expectations rather than a salary headline.
roles: Review security analyst versus governance pathways in US financial and cloud technology teams; compare shifts, clearance requirements and breach escalation ownership.
Compare cloud infrastructure and SRE advertisements in the US: production access, incident rotation, service-level objectives and location restrictions can differ greatly.
For US finance roles separate licensed client advice from corporate risk and analytics; verify required registration before you shortlist.
In US life-sciences teams distinguish bench research, clinical operations and product quality; validate whether regulated experience is mandatory.
US industrial roles can split plant engineering from software-enabled operations; check PE licensing where relevant and actual travel expectations.

countries.name: Canada
countries.locations: Toronto, Vancouver, Montréal, Ottawa and province-specific hybrid roles
countries.visa: Check federal work permits and the applicable provincial professional rules; French-language requirements can be material in some positions.
countries.screen: Compare province, language expectation, credential recognition and hybrid attendance before applying.
roles: Canadian cybersecurity roles may mix privacy governance with technical security; check whether bilingual client communication is part of the job.
For Canadian cloud roles examine data residency, incident rotation and the province in which remote work is permitted.
When reviewing Canadian banking compliance vacancies, verify local financial-services frameworks and bilingual requirements rather than inferring them from an international title.
A Canadian biotech vacancy may require provincial licensing for clinical roles while research roles may follow different credential pathways.
Canadian energy engineering advertisements can involve provincial professional standards and remote field locations; validate both before estimating moving costs.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.locations: London, Manchester, Edinburgh, Cambridge and UK-based remote roles
countries.visa: Confirm the employer's UK sponsorship policy directly; check professional recognition rather than assuming a global company sponsors each listing.
countries.screen: Consider pension, commuting, contracted hours and the precise UK city alongside base pay.
roles: In UK cyber hiring, separate hands-on security operations from assurance and audit responsibilities; read whether clearance or sector-specific controls matter.
UK cloud platform work may emphasize regulated availability and infrastructure cost management; clarify rota and data governance ownership.
For UK banking and insurance jobs, distinguish FCA-regulated functions from internal control roles; confirm required experience without assuming the same licensing applies.
In UK pharma research, check whether the position is laboratory, clinical, quality or medical-device focused; these have very different safeguards.
UK energy engineering requires checking site travel, chartership expectations and the boundary between design and operational responsibility.

countries.name: Australia
countries.locations: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and state-limited remote roles
countries.visa: Verify Australian work rights and state-specific registration requirements; remote roles may still require residing in Australia.
countries.screen: Study superannuation, regional travel, roster patterns and working-hour obligations.
roles: Australian security jobs in government-linked environments may require specific clearance and citizenship; verify these before investing in applications.
Australian cloud roles can span corporate platforms and mining operations; compare cloud-first versus on-site reliability expectations.
In Australian risk and insurance roles review regulatory reporting duties and whether local professional memberships are essential.
Australian medtech opportunities may involve clinical support, product quality or research; check any Australian professional registration.
Energy and resources engineering in Australia often changes greatly with fly-in/fly-out rosters and site access, so examine location details early.

countries.name: Germany
countries.locations: Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt, Hamburg and local language-dependent roles
countries.visa: Check work authorization and whether German-language proficiency is mandatory; EU recognition differs by occupation.
countries.screen: Evaluate German-language levels, collective agreements, relocation and qualification recognition.
roles: German security consulting roles may demand German-language reporting and industry standards knowledge; do not assume English-only work.
For Germany-based cloud jobs, investigate data protection responsibilities, German-language operations and whether the role permits hybrid work.
German banking compliance work can be centered in Frankfurt but requires employer-specific language and financial-rule expertise.
German pharma and medical-device roles often demand documentation discipline and language skills across quality processes; verify exact role requirements.
German industrial automation roles may require on-site commissioning, trade qualifications and standards-specific safety evidence.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.locations: Zurich, Basel, Zug, Geneva and canton-specific positions
countries.visa: Swiss permits and employer eligibility depend on nationality and canton; healthcare and other regulated roles can require qualification recognition.
countries.screen: Review canton, commuting, insurance costs and required local languages before comparing gross compensation.
roles: Swiss cybersecurity jobs can involve banking confidentiality and independent assurance; verify whether local-language or financial-control experience is required.
Swiss cloud-engineering vacancies should be read for data-location constraints and financial-services operational resilience, not just the cloud stack.
For Swiss finance roles compare private-banking, risk and audit teams and confirm regulatory responsibilities and local-language requirements.
In Basel-area life-sciences searches distinguish laboratory scientist, process quality and clinical functions; verify credential equivalence early.
Swiss industrial engineering applications benefit from documented commissioning evidence and understanding of canton and language expectations.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.locations: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Eindhoven, Utrecht and Dutch-location hybrid posts
countries.visa: Verify Dutch residence/work conditions and highly skilled migrant sponsorship with the employer; English-only assumptions should be checked per vacancy.
countries.screen: Compare commuting, pension arrangements, employment contract type and Dutch-language needs.
roles: Dutch cybersecurity work can involve multinational privacy and cloud assurance; check how much client-facing Dutch is expected.
For cloud jobs in the Netherlands, clarify whether the role owns platform reliability, data governance or customer delivery.
Dutch finance compliance postings may mix EU cross-border controls with domestic obligations; check local experience and language requirements.
Dutch life-sciences roles span university labs, clinical suppliers and regulated product teams; distinguish research from clinical practice.
For Netherlands engineering compare port automation, industrial controls and energy-grid roles with attention to on-site operations.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.locations: Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick and Ireland-only remote positions
countries.visa: Review Irish permission to work, employment permit eligibility and employer sponsorship; a US-headquartered company may have distinct Irish contracts.
countries.screen: Check housing and commuting costs, local employment terms and whether remote work is limited to Ireland.
roles: Irish cyber roles often serve regional operations; verify what security incidents are handled locally and whether time-zone shifts apply.
For Ireland cloud jobs compare on-call scope, region-specific operations and actual responsibility for platform changes.
Ireland-based financial compliance jobs may involve EU reporting and multinational functions; document the relevant control experience.
Irish life-sciences hiring can involve manufacturing validation and quality systems; verify what hands-on regulated experience is required.
Industrial engineering roles in Ireland may emphasize plant reliability, automation and safety documentation; compare shift and site requirements.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.locations: Singapore city and Singapore-resident hybrid roles
countries.visa: Confirm Singapore Employment Pass or other work-pass criteria with the employer and current official requirements; availability is not implied.
countries.screen: Compare work-pass feasibility, employer location, hours and healthcare/benefits, not gross pay alone.
roles: Singapore cybersecurity vacancies may support regional security teams; check if the position needs financial-sector control frameworks.
Cloud jobs in Singapore can include regional infrastructure and data-residency work; verify which countries' systems the team manages.
Singapore finance jobs often have regional regulatory exposure; distinguish compliance oversight from trade execution and sales.
Singapore life-sciences roles can span biomedical research and regional quality functions; verify technical or registered professional requirements.
Industrial and energy roles in Singapore often intersect with automation and maritime operations; check site schedules and safety responsibilities.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.locations: Dubai, Abu Dhabi and employer-specific UAE locations
countries.visa: Work permits are employer- and visa-category dependent; never infer sponsorship from an international job search result.
countries.screen: Verify actual contract currency, health coverage, dependent benefits and on-site hours before comparing packages.
roles: UAE cyber opportunities may be tied to large enterprise or finance environments; verify access requirements, security screening and locality.
Cloud infrastructure jobs in the UAE may require customer-site delivery; clarify travel, support windows and responsibilities.
UAE banking compliance job titles vary by institution; check regulatory oversight scope and whether prior GCC experience is mandatory.
Healthcare technology roles in the UAE may be technical rather than licensed clinical practice; verify local authority requirements carefully.
UAE infrastructure engineering roles can involve construction delivery and commissioning; check contract terms, site safety and city location.
